minor_findings.summary: Unicode display forms were normalized in metadata and one intermediate output.
minor_findings.evidence: The candidate uses an en dash instead of the original em dash in the title and ASCII '6' instead of full-width '６' in the yield and custards output label. The underlying recipe meaning is unchanged.

rationale: All six ingredients, both setup requirements, the four-operation chain, every direct input, duration, temperature, completion criterion, and output role are preserved. Three Unicode presentation forms differ, but they do not alter the graph or culinary meaning, so the candidate remains semantically equivalent under the formula.
